data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.notes: PowerShell is built on .NET and supports its rich type system.

operators.title: Operators
operators.notes: Comparison operators start with a dash (-eq, -ne, -gt, -lt, -like).

conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.notes: Uses standard C-style if/else blocks with PowerShell comparison operators.

functions.title: Functions
functions.notes: Functions use standard Verb-Noun naming convention, support complex parameters.

arrays.title: Arrays
arrays.code:
$fruits = @("apple", "banana", "cherry")
$fruits[0]

# Better to use ArrayList or generic List for dynamic sizing
$list = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
$list.Add("date")
arrays.notes: Arrays are immutable by default; appending creates a new array.

maps.title: Dictionaries / Hashtables
maps.notes: Hashtables are created using @{ key = value }.

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.notes: Use try/catch/finally blocks. Note the use of '-ErrorAction Stop' to force terminating errors.

comments.title: Comments & Script Headers
comments.code:
# Single-line comment in PowerShell
<#
 Multi-line comment block
 #>
<#
.SYNOPSIS
 Cmdlet documentation
#>
comments.notes: PowerShell uses # for comments with script headers.

numbers.title: Numbers & Arithmetic
numbers.notes: PowerShell supports shell integer arithmetic and numeric expressions.

booleans.title: Booleans & Exit Codes
booleans.notes: PowerShell evaluates boolean status through exit codes (0 = success) and boolean primitives.

type_casting.title: Type Casting & Coercion
type_casting.notes: PowerShell handles type conversion explicitly via type accelerators [type] or arithmetic evaluation.

strings.title: Strings & Quoting
strings.notes: PowerShell differentiates between single quotes (literal) and double quotes (variable expansion).

string_formatting.title: String Interpolation
string_formatting.notes: PowerShell provides in-string variable interpolation and printf formatting.

pattern_matching.title: Pattern Matching & Case
pattern_matching.notes: PowerShell matches patterns with case statements or switch blocks with glob matching.

range.title: Ranges & Sequences
range.notes: PowerShell constructs ranges with brace expansion {start..end} or range operators ..

iterators.title: Pipes & Iterators
iterators.notes: PowerShell streams data elements through command pipelines and loop iteration.

oop_classes.title: Classes / Structured Functions
oop_classes.notes: PowerShell defines reusable components through classes (PowerShell 5+) or modular functions.

lists.title: Arrays & Collections
lists.notes: PowerShell manages arrays using array lists @() or whitespace-delimited shell arrays.

tuples.title: Tuples & Records
tuples.notes: PowerShell emulates tuples through string delimiters, .NET Tuples, or positional variables.

sets.title: Sets & Unique Lists
sets.notes: PowerShell models unique sets using associative arrays or underlying runtime sets.

modules_import.title: Sourcing & Modules
modules_import.notes: PowerShell imports external functions using source (. in POSIX) or Import-Module.
